mechanism: In the playlist page content list, every song row build passes sid/index to SongCard as this.list.indexOf(item), twice per row. indexOf is a linear scan over the whole (potentially 1000+) song list, so rendering/scrolling the playlist costs O(n) per row and O(n^2) cumulative, wasting UI-thread time as the list grows.
fix_summary: The index already provided by the LazyForEach item generator is passed to SongCard, removing both per-row linear scans.

performance_oracle.definition: Sampled retired-instruction period sum (hw-instructions) attributed to the app process in the complete externally driven measured window.
performance_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant
